arxiv-2103-14391.title: Deuterium-tritium fusion process in strong laser fields: Semiclassical simulation
arxiv-2103-14391.creator: Shiwei Liu 1 , Hao Duan 2 , Difa Ye 2, Jie Liu 3,4
arxiv-2103-14391.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the deuterium-tritium (DT) fusion process in the presence of strong laser fields with a semiclassical (SC) method. In this model, two nuclei with a given incident kinetic energy that closely approach each other are simulated by tracing the classical Newtonian trajectories in the combined Coulomb repulsive potentials and laser fields.

arxiv-2104-03330.title: Gauge-Invariant Tensor Perturbations Induced from Baryon-CDM Relative Velocity and the B-mode Polarization of the CMB
arxiv-2104-03330.creator: James Gurian, Donghui Jeong, Jai-chan Hwang, Hyerim Noh
arxiv-2104-03330.description: Abstract At second order, scalar perturbations can source traceless and transverse perturbations to the metric, called induced gravitational waves (IGW). The apparent gauge-dependence of the IGW obscures the interpretation of the stochastic gravitational-wave signal. To elucidate the gauge dependence, we study the IGW from manifestly gauge-invariant scalar perturbations, namely, the relative velocity between baryons and cold dark matter.

arxiv-2104-04762.title: Search for charged Higgs bosons produced in vector boson fusion processes and decaying into vector boson pairs in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2104-04762.description: Abstract A search for charged Higgs bosons produced in vector boson fusion processes and decaying into vector bosons, using proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV at the LHC, is reported. The data sample corresponds to an integrated luminosity of 137 \fbinv collected with the CMS detector.

arxiv-2202-13590.title: LCP-dropout: Compression-based Multiple Subword Segmentation for Neural Machine Translation
arxiv-2202-13590.creator: Keita Nonaka, Kazutaka Yamanouchi, Tomohiro I, Tsuyoshi Okita, Kazutaka Shimada, Hiroshi Sakamoto
arxiv-2202-13590.description: Abstract In this study, we propose a simple and effective preprocessing method for subword segmentation based on a data compression algorithm. Compression-based subword segmentation has recently attracted significant attention as a preprocessing method for training data in Neural Machine Translation. Among them, BPE/BPE-dropout is one of the fastest and most effective method compared to conventional approaches.

arxiv-2211-05401.title: Quantum dynamics of gravitational massive shell
arxiv-2211-05401.creator: Andrzej Góźdź, Marcin Kisielowski, Włodzimierz Piechocki
arxiv-2211-05401.description: Abstract The quantum dynamics of a self-gravitating thin matter shell in vacuum has been considered. Quantum Hamiltonian of the system is positive definite. Within chosen set of parameters, the quantum shell bounces above the horizon. Considered quantum system does not collapse to the gravitational singularity of the corresponding classical system.

arxiv-2405-15539.title: A generalized neural tangent kernel for surrogate gradient learning
arxiv-2405-15539.creator: Luke Eilers, Raoul-Martin Memmesheimer, Sven Goedeke
arxiv-2405-15539.description: Abstract State-of-the-art neural network training methods depend on the gradient of the network function. Therefore, they cannot be applied to networks whose activation functions do not have useful derivatives, such as binary and discrete-time spiking neural networks. To overcome this problem, the activation function’s derivative is commonly substituted with a surrogate derivative, giving rise to surrogate gradient learning (SGL).

arxiv-2411-08431.title: Upper limit on dark matter mass in the inert doublet model
arxiv-2411-08431.creator: Wararat Treesukrat, Kem Pumsa-ard, Nopmanee Supanam, Patipan Uttayarat
arxiv-2411-08431.description: Abstract We study the upper limit on dark matter mass in the context of the inert doublet model. We derive an analytic expression for the upper bound as a function of the mass squared differences between dark matter and other new particles. We find that the upper limit varies between 20 and 80 TeV depending on the mass squared splitting.

arxiv-2501-06017.creator: Christian Bauer, Yoshiyuki Sakai, Markus Uhlmann
arxiv-2501-06017.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Christian Bauer, Yoshiyuki Sakai, Markus Uhlmann. arxiv-2505-16243.title: A novel splitting method for Vlasov-Ampère
arxiv-2505-16243.creator: James A. Rossmanith 1, Christine Vaughan 2
arxiv-2505-16243.description: Abstract Vlasov equations model the dynamics of plasma in the collisionless regime. A standard approach for numerically solving the Vlasov equation is to operator split the spatial and velocity derivative terms, allowing simpler time-stepping schemes to be applied to each piece separately (known as the Cheng-Knorr method).

arxiv-2510-08400.title: Classical Obfuscation of Quantum Circuits via Publicly-Verifiable QFHE
arxiv-2510-08400.creator: James Bartusek, Aparna Gupte, Saachi Mutreja, Omri Shmueli
arxiv-2510-08400.description: Abstract A classical obfuscator for quantum circuits is a classical program that, given the classical description of a quantum circuit Q Q , outputs the classical description of a functionally equivalent quantum circuit Q ~ \widetilde{Q} that hides as much as possible about Q Q .

pmc-11573235.title: Perceived Stress Among Private School Teachers in Chengalpattu District, Tamil Nadu, India: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11573235.creator: Lavanya M, Pradeep MVM, Anantharaman VV, Logaraj M
pmc-11573235.description: BackgroundTeachers are the cornerstone of any civilized society, preserving knowledge, wisdom, and ideals. Along with job-related stress, teachers face a variety of challenging circumstances in the classroom. This includes thoughts concerning a lack of professional appreciation, challenges maintaining classroom discipline, a lack of peer support, and extra duties like surveys and government mandates.

pmc-11608724.title: Chronic pyloric obstruction caused by Flammulina mushroom: A rare case report
pmc-11608724.creator: Zhaohui Liu, Ruinuan Wu, Zepeng Wang, Dayong Sun, Xiangyu Wang
pmc-11608724.description: Rationale:We report a rare case of chronic pyloric obstruction lasting 4 years. During the endoscopy examination, the cause was found to be foreign matter blocking the pylorus. We assessed the patient’s medical history and ultimately considered chronic pyloric obstruction caused by blockage of the Flammulina mushroom.

pmc-11631386.title: Caesarean section and operative vaginal delivery in Estonia and Finland from 1992 to 2016: registry-based study
pmc-11631386.creator: Kaire Sildver, Piret Veerus, Mika Gissler, Katrin Lang, Heti Pisarev
pmc-11631386.description: Proportion of normal deliveries is decreasing worldwide. This study analysed operative vaginal deliveries (OVD) and Caesarean sections (CS) with some background factors in Estonia and Finland from 1992 to 2016. Data on all deliveries from 1992 to 2016 were obtained from the Finnish Medical Birth Registry (1 481 160 births) and the Estonian Medical Birth Registry (356 063 births).

pmc-11651065.title: Transoral Laser Microsurgery and Transoral Robotic Surgery in Aging Patients: A State-of-The-Art Review
pmc-11651065.creator: Jerome R Lechien
pmc-11651065.description: PurposeIn the present study, the findings related to the epidemiology, clinical presentation, and therapeutic outcomes of elderly patients treated with transoral laser microsurgery (TOLM) and transoral robotic surgery (TORS) for supraglottic laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma (LSCC) have been reviewed.MethodsA PubMed, Cochrane Library, and Scopus literature search was conducted according to the PRISMA statements.

pmc-11656411.title: Novel Pinhole Emitter Chip for Micro Supercritical Fluid Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry with Integrated Dilution-Free Fluidic Back-Pressure Regulation
pmc-11656411.creator: Julius Schwieger, Chris Weise, Detlev Belder
pmc-11656411.description: We present a novel chip-based device featuring a pinhole emitter for mass spectrometry (MS) coupling with integrated fluidic back-pressure regulation for supercritical mobile phases. This design enables facile coupling of packed capillary columns used for supercritical fluid chromatography (SFC) with atmospheric pressure ionization mass spectrometry.

pmc-12564782.title: Hostility in the ICU Waiting Room: Extrapunitive and Intropunitive Reactions Among Family Members
pmc-12564782.creator: Zoe Konstanti, Fotios Tatsis, Konstantinos Stamatis, Foteini Veroniki, Georgios Papathanakos, Vasilios Koulouras, Mary Gouva, Manuel Pabón Carrasco, Rocío Cáceres-Matos
pmc-12564782.description: Background/Objectives: Families of ICU patients endure intense psychological strain. While anxiety and depression are well documented, less attention has been given to hostility—expressed both outwardly as anger and inwardly as guilt or self-criticism. Hostility, however, often shapes the climate of the ICU waiting room and the collaboration between families and staff.

pmc-12646141.title: Rectus diastasis repair with and without mesh at 1 year: randomized clinical trial
pmc-12646141.creator: Reetta Tuominen, Julia Saxen, Tiina Jahkola, Jani Mikkonen, Jari Arokoski, Hannu Luomajoki, Jaana Vironen
pmc-12646141.description: BackgroundRectus diastasis (RD) can cause functional impairment and pain. Surgical approaches vary regarding mesh use for linea alba restoration. The aim of this RCT was to compare plication supported by mesh (PSUM) with suture plication in patients with symptomatic postpartum RD.MethodsThis single-centre superiority double-blind RCT was conducted in Finland from April 2018 to November 2022.

pmc-13253098.title: Spontaneous facial expressivity predicts real-world social network size and richness
pmc-13253098.creator: Eithne Kavanagh, Alisa Balabanova, Jasmine Rollings, Robin I.M. Dunbar, Jamie Whitehouse, Bridget M. Waller
pmc-13253098.description: SummaryHumans have highly expressive faces, yet from an evolutionary perspective, the adaptive benefit of such expressivity remains unclear. One possibility is that facial expressivity confers social benefits. Here, we provide empirical support for this idea by demonstrating associations between individual-level facial expressivity and social network metrics.

pmc-13548671.title: Climate classification, sociodemographic development, and the burden of inflammatory bowel disease in tropical countries
pmc-13548671.creator: Sijie Gong, Jianwei Yu, Feiyang Zhong, Pingyu Zhong, Qinfen Lan, Xuejing Zhong
pmc-13548671.description: BackgroundGeographic definitions of the tropics may obscure substantial climatic heterogeneity. Climate classification provides a more ecologically meaningful framework for evaluating inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) in tropical settings. However, few studies have examined tropical IBD burden using an integrated framework that combines climate classification, sociodemographic development, decomposition analysis, frontier analysis, and long-term forecasting.

pmc-13549179.title: Core Elements of the Stunting Prevention Model to Improve Adolescents’ Quality of Life
pmc-13549179.creator: Eva Santi Hutasoit, Puspa Sari, Yenni Zuhairini, Dany Hilmanto
pmc-13549179.description: BackgroundStunting is a public health problem influenced by biological, behavioral, family, social, environmental, and health system factors throughout the life cycle. Factors such as poor reproductive health, anemia in adolescents, low health literacy, early marriage, socioeconomic conditions, and limited access to health services increase the risk of intergenerational stunting. However, adolescent-focused stunting prevention approaches as pre-pregnancy strategies are still limited.
